overall_assessment: All 28 packet entries were read in full as supplied, including their removed spans; packet truncation limits visibility beyond the displayed material. Standard coordinator blocks, emails and FS timestamps are removed successfully, and none of the eight random controls shows a confirmed defect (cohort years in progression conditions are substantive conditions). Five suspect plans retain lecturer names; other defects concern administrative dates, reference-date removal and local text loss/corruption: phone flags are identifier/URL false alarms, most name_like flags are authors, titles or organisations, high removed-share flags reflect short plans rather than lost content, and artifact flags mix pre-existing empty bibliography placeholders with removal-created reference damage.

findings.description: Five of 28 plans retain institutional lecturers: courses 2, 4, 15, 18 and 19. The name_label flags are real leaks, including Norwegian Foreleser and English Lecturer labels, multiple names and initials. Removing emails and semester/year values leaves the names visible; literature author names elsewhere are legitimate and should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R::.anon_hiof() only strips lecturer lines starting Foreleser(e) studieåret. It misses Foreleser høst and Lecturer spring/year variants; generic role patterns do not catch the resulting lines.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_hiof(), remove complete line-anchored Foreleser/Forelesere/Lecturer/Lecturers contact lines, allowing optional semester or academic-year text before the colon and a following name line. Run before generic semester/email removal and cover comma-separated names and initials.

findings.evidence: Litteratur vil være tilgjengelig innen 1. juni 2020.
findings.description: Administrative scheduling/publication dates survive in three plans: oktober 2015 for the opening session, 1. juni 2020 for reading-list availability, and Universityvåren 2019 for a workshop. These are course-offering dates, not publication dates of cited works. The glued season/year in course 15 is also missed by the pre-pass admin_date flag.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The generic long-date rules require approval/update cues, omit month-plus-year scheduling contexts, and require a word boundary before season words. .anon_hiof() has no targeted rules for these scheduling/availability phrases.
findings.suggested_fix: Add contextual HiØ rules for oppstartsamling i <month> <year> and Litteratur vil være tilgjengelig innen <date>. Recognize a semester/year after a lowercase-to-uppercase or institution-name text boundary such as Universityvåren, while preserving the adjacent institution name and leaving reference dates untouched.

findings.description: The explicit reading/access date remains in course 7. It dates the administrative consultation of a source, rather than the government document itself, so it does not qualify for the rubric exception for government publication dates. Another malformed access date is only partly removed, leaving (Lesedato:.20).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R::.not_gov protects dates based on any nearby lovdata/rundskriv/lov keyword, without distinguishing Lesedato from the date of the document. The clock rule separately consumes 12:05 in a malformed access date.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove complete parenthesized Lesedato/accessed/retrieved-date fields before government-date guards and clock removal, accepting the observed dotted and colon-separated variants; continue preserving actual law, regulation and document dates.

findings.evidence: [−(18.11.2014)−] Should Jews visit the Temple Mount?
findings.description: Three religion plans lose publication dates from literature entries (including newspaper articles and institutional web sources) and edition/access ranges such as (2016-17), which are reference metadata rather than course semesters. In both 2017 plans, deleting the date embedded in Rapport_UDA_7.6.2011.pdf changes the reference URL to Rapport_UDA_.pdf. Some artifact flags reflect this damage, including F.S.(); other apparent author removals in the diff still leave the author in the displayed result and are not counted as lost names.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Generic numeric-date rules protect only limited reference punctuation and immediate path boundaries. They remove parenthesized publication dates and dates within filenames; academic-year rules also mistake consecutive-year reference metadata for offering years.
findings.suggested_fix: Protect full URL tokens before date removal. Within HiØ literature sections, retain dates/ranges attached to bibliographic entries and apply administrative removal only to explicit update, availability, contact or offering fields; retain removal of genuine semester labels outside reference entries.

findings.evidence: [−Litteraturliste er sist oppdatert 3. desember 2015. Kompendium for emnet selges i bokhandel: inneholder enkeltkapitler, artikler og utdrag−]
findings.description: The update-stamp removal also deletes the following sentence about purchasing the course compendium and its contents. The update date should go, but the literature-availability information is course content and must remain. This collateral loss is not identifiable from the pre-pass flags alone.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R::.anon_hiof() removes everything to the end of a line beginning Litteratur... sist oppdater, including subsequent content sentences on that line.
findings.suggested_fix: Bound the HiØ literature-update rule to the matched update phrase and its date, with an optional terminating full stop, instead of consuming the remainder of the line. Preserve any following compendium or reading-list instructions.

findings.evidence: Emnet har oppstartsamling i oktober 2015, og foregår i høst- og tidlig.
findings.description: Semester removal leaves an unfinished scheduling clause: høst- og tidlig has lost the spring-semester noun. Unlike a harmless empty administrative label, this is a broken sentence describing course duration. The artifact flag on this course also has a false-positive source: the empty (s. ) [ ] bibliography placeholder is unchanged by the displayed removals.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The generic semester/year rule removes vårsemester 2016 while preserving the preceding coordinated seasonal phrase and modifier tidlig.
findings.suggested_fix: For coordinated season expressions in course scheduling, remove the year while retaining the seasonal duration (høst- og tidlig vårsemester), or remove the entire dated scheduling clause with its joining punctuation. Avoid leaving adjectives or conjunctions without their complement.
